title: Mike Tomlin joins NBC for ‘Sunday Night Football' pregame show

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Mike Tomlin joins NBC for ‘Sunday Night Football' pregame show
sources.description: After 19 seasons with the Steelers, the Super Bowl-winning coach will take his talents to NBC as part of the "Sunday Night Football" pregame show.
